children: Freshworks reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $245.43 million, up 14.1% from a year earlier, while net income was $18.3 million compared with a $4.68 million loss. Diluted EPS was $0.07 versus a loss of $0.02 per share in the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per share attributable to common stockholders”.
Revenue increased 14% in the quarter and 15% year to date, supported by existing customers and new customer additions.
Customers generating more than $5,000 in annual recurring revenue grew 5% to 25,498. Net dollar retention was 104%, compared with 105% a year earlier, partly reflecting currency movements.
Freshworks’ AI offerings span employee and customer service. FireHydrant joined the company in January, while acquisitions of Torii and Robusta closed in October.
Third-quarter operating expenses fell 4%, reflecting lower stock-based compensation, restructuring-related headcount reductions and reduced marketing costs.
The company expects to continue investing in product development, customer acquisition, infrastructure and support, while noting that macroeconomic and currency uncertainty may affect demand.
